text:
ara_sales: Heads-up — AcmeTech wants to POC replacing QuickCall's summarize+qa endpoint. Main asks: preserve streaming UX, match response envelope (they have a `segment_id` per chunk), give an estimate on token cost delta, and complete their security questionnaire. Can we scope?

Drew_SE: quick clarifying q: do they rely on QuickCall's custom metadata per chunk (segment_id + cursor)? if yes we need to either emit identical fields or provide a light mapping layer. sample payload from them?

ara_sales: pasted from procurement: ```POST /v1/answers/summarize
{ "doc": "...", "stream": true, "format": "segmented" }```
and chunk events look like: ```{ "kind":"update", "segment_id": "s-22", "text": "Summary part...", "tok_count": 42 }```

Drew_SE: ok. Redwood streaming uses newline-delimited JSON with keys {"type":"partial","delta":"...","final":false}. We can add compat headers: include segment_id and tok_count in metadata when client requests `compat=quickcall`. Implementation work ~1-2 dev days for an SDK shim.

jin_infra: infra notes: for POC in EU we can spin a Dedicated trial in eu-west-1, VPC peering available, static egress IPs, and we support customer-managed KMS for key material. Time to provision peering + IPs ~3 business days. On-prem packaged Private deploy adds ~4-6 weeks.

maria_legal: security questionnaire red flags to expect: data residency proof, subprocessor list, incident SLA, breach notification window, and export controls. We can provide SOC2 Type II link and complete their vendor form. Default log retention policy: 30 days; can extend per contract.

ava_qabot: automated note: compare_tokenizers job shows QuickCall uses proprietary tokenization which inflates tokens by ~18% vs GPT-style tokenizers on our models. Per-model delta ranges 10-25%.

Drew_SE: pricing implication: if current spend is $0.00085/token on QuickCall at 150M/mo, a +18% delta is material. Proposed go-to-customer for POC: 1) 4-week POC cap = $8k flat including up to 12M tokens; 2) optional reserved capacity pricing if commit to 6mo with volume discounts starting at $0.00058/token. Also recommend enabling prefix caching and batching to reduce delta.

ara_sales: acceptance criteria for POC (suggested):
- Streaming parity: first 3 chunks for 100 sample docs must have identical segment_id mapping and ordering
- Latency SLO: median chunk-to-client <120ms in EU region
- Output quality: ROUGE-L on summaries within 2% of QuickCall baseline on a 200-doc eval set
- Billing reconciliation: token delta measured and reported weekly during POC

Drew_SE: test plan: we provide a small compatibility adapter example:```js
// pseudo
const stream = fetch(redwoodUrl, {headers:{"x-compat":"quickcall"}})
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  // adapter maps {type:..} -> {kind: 'update', segment_id: ...}
}
```
Also add automated diff script that compares visible text between QuickCall and Redwood per chunk and flags >5% character diffs.

jin_infra: provisioning action: if they want EU-only tenancy we need signed DPA + their list of allowed IPs. I'll open a ticket for VPC peering and reserve IPs once legal confirms DPA terms.

maria_legal: I'll return signed DPA draft and the standard security package (SOC2, penetration summary, subprocessor list). Note: procurement may request contract clause to cap token-based charges during migration; be prepared to discuss a time-limited credit or blended rate.

ara_sales: blockers to surface to AcmeTech: potential token count differences, the need for a small shim if they depend on exact QuickCall envelope, and provisioning lead time for EU peering. If they accept mapping shim, risk is low.

Drew_SE: follow-ups for our team: 1) I will build shim PR and smoke test (2 dev days) 2) QA will run chunk-diff suite on 1000 docs (automated) 3) infra to confirm peering ETA 4) finance to draft POC pricing + reserved capacity SKU.

ara_sales: can someone draft a 1-page POC statement of work I can send to procurement? Need it by Wednesday EOD.

Drew_SE: I'll draft SOW + attach sample curl/snippet and the compatibility notes.

maria_legal: I'll attach DPA + security pack once draft is ready.

ava_qabot: ci job status: compatibility-diff/1000 run queued — ETA 6h.

ara_sales: thanks all. tagging @drew_se @jin_infra @maria_legal. scheduling kickoff Fri 09:30 CET with AcmeTech procurement.

Drew_SE: noted. I'll bring the shim demo and the initial delta numbers.
